canonical_question: What specific oxidation or corrosion environment was tested to confirm the 'protective Al 2 O 3 and Cr 2 O 3' layers?

question_variants.question: What specific oxidation or corrosion environment was tested to confirm the 'protective Al 2 O 3 and Cr 2 O 3' layers?
question_variants.resolution_summary: The text confirms HESAs form protective Al2O3 and Cr2O3 layers for good resistance against high temperature oxidation and corrosion, but does not specify the exact environment (e.g., gas composition, pressure) in which these were tested.

answers.answer: HESAs show good resistance against high temperature oxidation and corrosion by forming protective Al2O3 and Cr2O3 layers.
answers.measurement_outcome: formation of protective Al2O3 and Cr2O3
answers.boundary_limitation: Specific environment (gas, pressure, time) details not provided in the text.
evidence_spans: Previous studies have shown that the γ - γ′ microstructure of HESAs can remain stable against topologically-close-packed (TCP) phase formation from 700 to 1100 °C for at least 500 h [15] , and with enhanced γ′ solvus temperatures above 1150 °C [16] .
Furthermore, HESAs have shown good resistances against high temperature oxidation and corrosion by forming protective Al 2 O 3 and Cr 2 O 3 , respectively [17] .
